design_concept: A high-efficiency, clutter-free operations dashboard tailored for an IT repair shop. It uses a stark monochrome foundation (whites, grays, blacks) offset by a single, high-contrast 'Technical Apple Green' accent. This ensures maximum legibility, fast scanning, and a modern, authoritative feel.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, card headers, and major data points.

body.usage: Use for all table data, form labels, descriptions, and secondary text.

mono.usage: Use for repair ticket IDs, amounts in the cash register, and technical data.

primary.description: Technical Apple Green (Tailwind lime-500/600). Use exclusively for primary CTAs (Create Ticket, Finish Repair, Generate PDF), active states, and key success metrics.

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8

grid_system.dashboard_cards: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

buttons.primary: bg-[#84CC16] hover:bg-[#65A30D] text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-600 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6
cards.metric: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6 flex flex-col justify-between

inputs.default: w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#84CC16] focus:border-transparent transition-shadow
inputs.search: w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border border-slate-300 rounded-md bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#84CC16] transition-all

tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-y border-slate-200 text-slate-500 font-medium py-3 px-4

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

icons.usage: Use 16px (w-4 h-4) for inline text/buttons, 24px (w-6 h-6) for standard UI, 32px+ for empty states. Always ensure they align optically with adjacent text.

image_urls.description: Professional headshot for the logged-in user avatar (Shop Owner/Technician).

interactions_and_motion.hover: All interactive elements MUST have a visible hover state. Cards translate-y slightly, buttons change background/opacity.
interactions_and_motion.focus: Keyboard focus MUST be visible using ring-2 ring-lime-500 ring-offset-2.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use Tailwind's 'transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out' for smooth state changes on buttons, inputs, and cards.
interactions_and_motion.empty_states: Use an icon (lucide-react) + title + descriptive text + primary action button to guide the user when a table or list is empty.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on Apple Green meets 3:1 contrast for large text or use a slightly darker green (#65A30D) if needed for smaller text. Alternatively, use dark text on light green backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, row actions, tabs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Do not use random icon libraries.
Install Google Fonts: Outfit (Headings), IBM Plex Sans (Body), JetBrains Mono (Code/Numbers).
Implement Shadcn UI for core components: Table, Button, Input, Select, Dialog, Tabs, Card, Badge.
The layout should feature a sticky left sidebar (or bottom nav on mobile) and a main content area with a top header.
The dashboard should immediately display 'Journal de caisse' summary, 'Réparations en cours' table, and quick actions.
Ensure 'Recherche intelligente avec tolérance aux fautes' is implemented via a fuzzy search library like 'fuse.js' on the frontend or appropriate backend logic.
For the 'Fiches de réparation', implement the specific buttons requested: 'Créer fiche', 'Terminer', 'Générer PDF', 'Envoyer au client'.
Use JetBrains Mono for monetary values and repair ticket IDs to give a precise, technical feel.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Strictly use 'Outfit' or fallback to 'system-ui'.
Mobile-friendly is a hard requirement. Ensure tables can scroll horizontally on mobile, or switch to a card-based list view for clients/repairs on small screens.
